house-rules.what: House rules for Claude: working loop, code, errors and logs, access control, secrets, shared systems, git. A marker block in CLAUDE.local.md (repo) or ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (user).

permissions.what: Native permission rules: read-only git, gh and ls allowed; push and PR creation ask; force-push, reset --hard, rm -rf, printenv, gh auth token and .env files denied.

guard.what: PreToolUse hook: denies destructive, secret-revealing and supply-chain commands, asks before shared-system writes, logs each decision to dev-toolkit-logs/guard.jsonl in the repo's git dir.

gate.what: Opt-in Stop gate: blocks finishing once when code changed since the last passing test run. Off: a dev-toolkit-gate-off file in the git dir, or TK_GATE=off.

facts.what: Repo facts: detects stack, test, lint, typecheck and format commands, CI, services and conventions; in a repo it writes the facts block of CLAUDE.local.md and allow-lists the detected commands.

scope.what: /scope issues: <paths|#N|text>; constraints; rules: one Explore agent per issue, overlaps, a ranking by fix velocity, ONE self-contained plan file per issue in .claude/plan/ (template plan-template.md) plus index.md; questions only where readings differ; decisions recorded in the plan; waits for approval. A take-home brief is one plan with a fence and time plan.

repro-fix.what: /repro-fix [symptom]: failing test first, root cause in one sentence, minimal fix, sibling sweep, detection.

check.what: /check: the repository's own format check, lint, typecheck and tests with real output; new vs pre-existing failures; diff hygiene.

access-control.what: /access-control [action]: single chokepoint, identity from the auth context, deny-by-default test matrix, one audit line per decision.

perf-baseline.what: /perf-baseline [scenario]: p50/p95 baseline with queue wait split out, profile, proportionate fix, before/after numbers.

pr-brief.what: /pr-brief [base]: PR title and body from the diff and real check output; creates nothing; user-invoked only.

verifier.what: Independent read-only verifier (sonnet): runs the checks and reports PASS or FAIL with evidence; never edits.

reviewer.what: Adversarial read-only reviewer (opus): correctness, bypasses, tests, security, scope, concision; CONFIRMED needs a reproducer; SHIP or FIX FIRST.

test-writer.what: Writes failing tests first, from a case table or a bug, in the repo's own framework; touches only test files; shows RED.

builder.what: Teammate role: builds one plan file from .claude/plan/ in its own worktree and branch; RED first, smallest fix at the cause, the repo's checks, QA hand-off, test-then-fix commits, a PR brief; edits only the files the plan owns.

qa.what: Teammate role: QA for a parallel build; re-runs each worktree's checks on GREEN, adversarial inputs through the real entrypoints, regression tests for confirmed gaps in that worktree's test files only, grades the tests; PASS or GAPS per plan with evidence; never edits production code.

tk-python.what: Path rule for *.py, pyproject.toml, requirements*.txt: runner, errors, timeouts, pathlib, logging, pytest tables.

tk-typescript.what: Path rule for *.ts, *.js, package.json, tsconfig*.json: package manager, no any, validation, timeouts, typed errors, tests.

tk-go.what: Path rule for *.go and go.mod: gofmt and vet clean, wrapped errors, context first, http timeouts, table tests.

tk-data-safety.what: Path rule for SQL, migrations and data-access code: parameterized queries, reversible migrations, batched backfills, idempotent writes, no production data in tests.

tk-tool-contracts.what: Path rule for CLI, tool and connector code: JSON on stdout, error envelope on stderr, exit-code map, dry run, idempotency, timeouts, retries, audit line.

break.what: /break [feature]: input-driven adversarial testing after GREEN: edge matrix, breaker agents on the real entrypoints, mutation score of the suite, every miss becomes a failing test.

breaker.what: Input-driven adversarial tester: mutates inputs, runs entrypoints and one-off reproducers, grades the tests; scratch files outside the checkout; CONFIRMED needs the output.

ship.what: /ship: pre-submission gate: tracked-file inventory, junk and secrets, history noise, README placeholders and length, rubric sections, the decision ledger, fresh-clone run of the README commands; drafts the submission note.

trail.what: UserPromptSubmit hook, in the live and takehome sets (elsewhere named explicitly): one redacted JSON line per prompt in dev-toolkit-logs/trail.jsonl in the repo's git dir, so what you asked and what the agent did can be told apart later.

parallel.what: /parallel plan <issues> | check: one worktree, branch and session per issue. Scripts wt-new, wtc, wt-board, wt-conflicts and wt-workspace make the worktrees (each with this checkout's Claude config), start named plan-mode sessions, show the board and prove branches don't conflict; the skill maps overlaps and launch order, then checks PRs before merge.

recon.what: /recon [topic]: read-only reconnaissance by four agents in one message (baseline, map of entrypoints to side effects, conventions, hotspots), written to .claude/plan/recon.md for /scope and the teammates; ends by asking for the issues, constraints and ground rules.

deslop.what: /deslop [base]: removes generated slop from the change (narrating comments, unused defensiveness, one-use wrappers, dead parameters, redundant tests) without changing behaviour; reports bulk against the brief.

tighten-docs.what: /tighten-docs [cap]: README skeleton with caps, detail into docs/, AGENTS.md under 40 lines, rubric sections deleted, AI-writing patterns flagged; Decisions and AI use left for you to write.

takehome-init.what: /takehome-init <brief>: a clean repo from the brief (no starter-kit history), ignore file, docs skeleton, AGENTS.md, the decision ledger docs/decisions.md (from its ledger.md), the fence around the prompt, the time plan with its slip rule; hands off to /scope.

gate-workflow.what: /gate [base]: eight review passes in parallel (checks, tests, scope, bypasses, security, reliability, concision, edges) and a refuter per high or medium finding; SHIP, FIX FIRST or INCOMPLETE.

teams.what: Agent teams switch: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 (the shared task list on every model) in the repo's settings, plus a hook that logs TaskCreated, TaskCompleted and TeammateIdle to dev-toolkit-logs/teams.jsonl in the repo's git dir and refuses a task completion that carries no evidence. In the named sets; `all` skips it.

team.what: /team build [plans] | review [base] | hunt <symptom>: build spawns one builder teammate per plan file in its own worktree and branch plus a qa teammate; review gives three reviewer teammates one lens each; hunt pits three hypotheses against each other. Teammates are Agent calls with a name; the lead re-runs the decisive command and gives the verdict.

worksheet.what: Fill-in sheet at .claude/worksheet.md for the brief: overview, tasks with indented sub-tasks, acceptance criteria per task, constraints, guardrails. Plain text, pre-formatted. Placed once and yours: re-runs and --update never rewrite an edited copy; /recon reads it when filled.
